core_features: Supernatural or magical elements hidden within or layered over a modern/urban setting
Coexistence or collision of mundane life and the magical world
Secret societies, supernatural factions, or hidden laws
typical_settings: Modern city streets, bars, clubs, subways
Ordinary apartments that hide supernatural activity
typical_conflicts: Protecting humans from unseen supernatural threats
Balancing normal life with magical duties
Inter-faction struggles within the hidden magical world
protagonist_archetypes: Reluctant mage or witch with a day job
tone_guidelines: Mix of everyday realism and uncanny; can be snarky, gritty, or melancholic.

required_elements: At least one supernatural being or magical entity interacting with everyday human spaces
A tension between 'normal life' and the magical world
forbidden_elements: Purely secondary-world medieval fantasy without any modern urban layer
